relationships.contract: ApplicationDeployment and complete current ComponentPlacement set
ApplicationDeployment identity and complete current placements
candidate Firewall and policy locator set
complete target-specific required policy or unresolved
source-qualified configured evidence when selected by an explicit source contract

strategic_invariants: each authoritative semantic fact or decision has one explicit owner
cross-context references are opaque semantic references rather than persistence foreign keys
no Shared Kernel is accepted between target Bounded Contexts
unknown or incomplete information never silently becomes absence, denial, empty policy or success
workflows may derive values but gain no business authority merely by orchestrating owners
provider-native semantics remain at integration boundaries
evidence alone never creates authorization, desired policy or mutation intent
